scenes.title: The Batch That Bit Back
scenes.storyBeat: A cupcake slime batch is hungry, sticky, and wrongly blamed.
storyboardPanels: Cupcake Slimes huddle around a dented tray.
A tiny slime gives a crumb to a jelly rat.

preChoiceDialogue.text: That is my tray, my frosting, and my emergency cupcake batch.
Dessert recovery target is also an improvised community meal.
I did not come here to steal dinner from something smaller than my mixing bowl.

choices.label: Scrape the Frosting Valve
choices.playerLine: Nobody eats beside a leaking valve. Back up. I am scraping this clean.
choices.narration: Pippa clears the frosting spill with careful bursts of fire. The slimes return when the floor is safe.

choices.label: Split the Emergency Batch
choices.playerLine: Half the tray comes home. Half stays here. Sit in a line and chew slowly.
choices.narration: The smallest slime reveals a sugar-marked tunnel map. The slimes were hiding food from a larger bully.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain healing and a warmer slime callback.

choices.label: Caramelize the Spillway
choices.playerLine: Stand clear. I am giving this sewer one proper caramel shell.

npcResponse.text: Caramelization radius exceeds polite dessert boundaries.

choices.narration: Pippa seals the leak in a shining amber crust. It is beautiful, effective, and too dramatic.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain rare gold with sticky risk.

postChoiceBarks.text: A tidy flame is still a flame. Respect both parts.

victoryCallback.text: The tray is lighter, the floor is safer, and nobody chewed through the handle.

bossCallback.text: I fed your little ones. We are having a very loud table-manners lesson.

scenes.locationName: Goblin Workshop - Trial Oven Assembly Line
scenes.title: The Oven That Would Not Listen
scenes.storyBeat: A goblin oven overheats because it was never taught to rest.
storyboardPanels: A sign reads PREHEAT FOREVER FOR BEST RESULTS.
The Trial Oven spits bomb blocks.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Preheat forever? Who wrote this? A spoon with confidence?
It gets very hot very quickly! That is like baking, yes?
That is arson wearing an apron.

choices.label: Douse the Overheat Tray
choices.playerLine: Water pan under the rack, vents open, sparks away from the dough.

npcResponse.text: But the sparks make it look successful!

choices.narration: Pippa lowers the oven heat and clears the most dangerous bomb blocks.

choices.label: Teach the Oven to Rest
choices.playerLine: A good oven breathes. Hot, then steady. Bright, then patient.

npcResponse.text: Oven temperament adjusted. Probability of edible machinery improved.

choices.narration: The oven glow softens. It learns heat can help without shouting.

choices.label: Flash-Bake the Gear Jam
choices.playerLine: Three seconds of festival heat and a lesson in crisp edges.

npcResponse.text: Temperature spike noted. Aromatic but hazardous.

choices.narration: Pippa flash-bakes the jammed gears loose. The belts run beautifully, then throw a warm screw.

postChoiceBarks.text: Proper heat, proper timing, fewer goblin lawsuits.

victoryCallback.text: Still ridiculous, but now it is ridiculous with a timer.

bossCallback.text: No. Steady heat. You will rise properly.

scenes.title: The Batch Under Ice
scenes.storyBeat: Frozen share-crates must be warmed without spoiling food.
storyboardPanels: Cake crates sit sealed beside gelato tubs.
An imp sneezes frost onto a pastry label.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Those are my festival sponge rolls. Frozen solid beside gelato. Storage crime with witnesses.
Warm too quickly and the cream splits.
That is why I am measuring my fury.

choices.label: Clear the Freezer Vents
choices.playerLine: Vents first. Then crates. Then a strongly worded tart.

npcResponse.text: A tart can be strongly worded?

choices.narration: Pippa clears ice from the vents with small controlled flames.

choices.label: Thaw by the Crumb
choices.playerLine: Low flame. Slow circle. A cake comes back quietly if you respect it.
choices.narration: The crates thaw without splitting, sagging, or flooding. Pippa sets aside a shared dessert bundle.
choices.gameplayResult: Heal and protect the pantry route.

choices.label: Crack the Sugar Ice
choices.playerLine: One clean crack. No crumbs lost, no gelato bullied.

npcResponse.text: Thermal confidence high. Dessert regret possible.

choices.narration: Pippa cracks the sugar ice in a bright ring. Rare ingredients tumble free with extra frost.

postChoiceBarks.text: Nobody is becoming regret on my watch.

victoryCallback.text: The cakes held shape. The gelato kept dignity. Acceptable.

bossCallback.text: Safe food still needs to be served.

scenes.title: The Rolls Before the Alarm
scenes.storyBeat: Sleepy guards need midnight rolls more than alarms.
storyboardPanels: Guards nap beside cold crumb plates.
Pippa finds an unused roll tray.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Those guards are not lazy. They are empty.
Finally, a castle policy I can support.

choices.label: Toast the Guard Crumbs
choices.playerLine: Crumbs first. Warm crumbs are morale with edges.
choices.narration: Pippa toasts stale crumbs into quick guard snacks and steadies the room.

choices.label: Bake Midnight Rolls
choices.playerLine: No alarms. Rolls. A warm guard wakes kindly.
choices.narration: Pippa bakes small midnight rolls and the guards wake by scent instead of panic.
choices.gameplayResult: Heal and soften Sleepy boss pressure.

choices.label: Torch the Blanket Tangle
choices.playerLine: I am using a precise flame. Anyone saying bonfire gets no roll.
choices.narration: Pippa burns away the tangle fast. It works, but the castle wakes brighter than planned.

victoryCallback.text: Fed, rested, and no one yelled into a pillow. Good service.

bossCallback.text: The baker with rolls. Sit up slowly.

scenes.title: The Prize Cake Problem
scenes.storyBeat: The prize cake tempts Pippa to win loudly or share fairly.
storyboardPanels: A prize cake spins under neon lights.

preChoiceDialogue.text: That cake is being treated like a trophy. Terrible use of cake.

choices.label: Win the Cake Fairly
choices.playerLine: Clean score, clean slice, clean tray.
choices.narration: Pippa wins without scorching the scoreboard and secures the prize table.

choices.label: Open the Shared Plate
choices.playerLine: Cake tastes better when nobody has to beat a hydra to smell it.
choices.narration: Pippa cuts the prize cake into fair slices. The arcade crowd cheers for the first low score that gets a plate.
choices.gameplayResult: Heal and improve final arcade callback.

choices.label: Flambe the Scoreboard
choices.playerLine: If the board insists on drama, I can plate drama.
choices.narration: Pippa turns the score display into a harmless crown of fire. The crowd loves it; the machine gets competitive.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain gold with preview pressure risk.

postChoiceBarks.text: A prize not shared is just frosting with an ego.

victoryCallback.text: The cake is gone. The plate is full of crumbs. Correct ending.

scenes.locationName: Bloxley's Block Palace - Square Banquet Hall
scenes.title: The Cake With No Give
scenes.storyBeat: Bloxley demands a square cake, but Pippa can bake structure with a soft center.
storyboardPanels: A flawless square cake sits under glass.
Royal blocks line up like hard frosting seams.
Pippa taps the cake and frowns.

preChoiceDialogue.text: This cake is perfect. That was not a compliment.
A cake should stand straight and never sag into sentiment!
A cake should make someone glad they came in from the cold.

choices.label: Loosen the Royal Frosting
choices.playerLine: Too tight, and the whole thing cracks under the knife.
choices.narration: Pippa softens the palace's frosting-like seals.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain shield for the final boss.

choices.label: Bake the Crooked Center
choices.playerLine: Proper edges. Clean corners. But the center stays soft.

npcResponse.text: A soft center is structural weakness!

choices.narration: Pippa bakes a square cake with warm golden edges and a tender center. The palace smells butter and reconsiders.
choices.gameplayResult: Royal warnings improve for the final boss.

choices.label: Crown the Cake in Fire
choices.playerLine: If His Majesty insists on theater, I can provide theater.

npcResponse.text: Royal flambe event detected. Dessert visibility exceptional.

choices.narration: Pippa crowns the square cake with harmless festival fire. The palace gasps and tightens its patterns.

postChoiceBarks.text: Corners are fine. Cruelty is not.

victoryCallback.text: The square held. The center stayed soft. That is baking.

bossCallback.text: Order must be firm! Corners must command!
A table can have corners and still make room.
